description: Ember Eye default look, PIXEL-SAMPLED from design/reference/ember_eye-character-sheet.png (sampler: service venv PIL; medians of each drawn surface, masks eroded 2-3 px off the ink outline). The five chips (intake.json swatches 250,8,30 / 115,33,33 / 253,165,166 / 244,243,243 / 85,22,21; printed hex FF0000 / 7A1F1F / FFB3B3 / FFFFFF / 531212) are cited per region. NO glow: the sheet draws none beyond the bright colours. The SOFT PINK chip is not drawn as such anywhere: the drawn pinks are 241-245,183-188 (side-flame streaks, the pupil's inner flame) and the upper flame's streak is a lighter red 248,77,79.
